steps.title: Mistakes are normal
steps.say: Every programmer writes code that doesn't build. The skill is reading the error. Let's make one on purpose.

steps.title: Open Main.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `Main` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Break it
steps.say: Delete the `;` at the end of the `println` line. A red squiggle appears right away: the editor checks your code as you type.

steps.title: The problem count
steps.say: The bottom-left corner counts problems. Click it to open the list: each one says the **file**, the **line**, and what's wrong.

steps.title: What the error says
steps.say: Java errors look scary but have the same shape every time.

board.caption: Read the first error first: later ones are often caused by it.

steps.title: Fix it
steps.say: Put the `;` back. The squiggle and the problem count disappear.
